title: capi2 Agent Intelligence input
description: Choose one intelligence tool. The Actor fetches public internet sources only and returns one structured result.

url.title: Public URL
url.description: Public HTTP(S) source or API URL. Required except for domain intelligence.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Domain name for domain intelligence, for example example.com.

query.title: Claim or query
query.description: Exact claim to verify or keywords/question used to rank passages.

request_type.title: Claim request type
request_type.description: Business context used to classify and format a claim-verification result.

max_passages.title: Maximum evidence passages
max_passages.description: Maximum number of ranked source passages returned in the result.

max_bytes.title: Maximum download bytes
max_bytes.description: Maximum number of bytes fetched from the public source URL.

include_rdap.title: Include RDAP registration metadata
include_rdap.description: Whether domain intelligence should include public RDAP registration data.
